requirements.evidence: All contract pieces are present: Entity/EntityMembership/UserRole models and User relations (app/Models/Entity.php:1-55, app/Models/EntityMembership.php:1-74, app/Models/UserRole.php:1-22, app/Models/User.php:34-60), migrations with the named indexes and stored owner_seq guard (database/migrations/2026_10_29_065431_create_entities_table.php:14-26, database/migrations/2026_10_29_065432_create_entity_memberships_table.php:14-34), both policies with the required signatures (app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:1-53, app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:1-52), factories (database/factories/EntityFactory.php:1-25, database/factories/EntityMembershipFactory.php:1-50), audit-logged pick controller (app/Http/Controllers/EntityPickController.php:15-29), the four routes with auth+verified and slug binding (routes/web.php:26-32), and both locales (lang/pt_BR/ui.php:50-77, lang/en/ui.php:50-77). Settings locks the bound entity and enforces owner-only mount/actions (app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:8-9,26-34), and transfer handles the vanished-owner case with 403 (Settings.php:68-87).

conventions.evidence: Most conventions are followed: deliberate #[Fillable] (app/Models/Entity.php:8), reversible generated migrations (database/migrations/2026_10_29_065431_create_entities_table.php:28-30), Blade components and Bulma markup (resources/views/livewire/entity/members.blade.php:9-18), #[Validate] on the email property (app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:112), and docs/CHANGELOG updates (docs/database-schema.md:1-6, CHANGELOG.md:9). However, conventions.md requires domain writes to go through app/Actions/* with authorization inside the action, yet membership writes, entity update/delete and ownership transfer are implemented inline in the components (app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:31-85, app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:35-91), and the pick controller authorizes by hand instead of using EntityPolicy::view (app/Http/Controllers/EntityPickController.php:17).

security.evidence: Every Livewire action re-authorizes server-side against policies (app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:33,55,72; app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:37,46,64), the entity is #[Locked] on all pages (app/Livewire/Entity/Dashboard.php:12-13, Members.php:12-13, Settings.php:8-9), action IDs are resolved inside the locked entity (app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:94-99, Settings.php:77-86), output uses {{ }} escaping (resources/views/livewire/entity/members.blade.php:36-77), and mass assignment is limited (app/Models/Entity.php:8). The one gap is $targetMembershipId, a client-writable public property with no #[Validate]/rules entry (app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:24, rules at 108-121), accepted only because transfer() rejects all invalid values with 403 (Settings.php:79-86).

tests.evidence: The change ships broad Pest coverage: schema/relations/DB guards (tests/Feature/EntityModelTest.php:20-108), policy matrix (tests/Feature/EntityPolicyTest.php:25-101), pick including audit log and untouched session (tests/Feature/EntityPickTest.php:13-54), members happy/validation/authorization/tamper paths (tests/Feature/EntityMembersTest.php:29-193), and settings update/delete/transfer paths (tests/Feature/EntitySettingsTest.php:36-159). Missing from the required set: no direct unauthorized-call test for Settings::save(), delete() or transfer() (only the mount 403 at EntitySettingsTest.php:47-59) and no tamper test proving the locked $entity cannot be swapped.

simplicity.evidence: Components are small and focused, local scopes are reused for role filters (app/Models/EntityMembership.php:55-73), and the member list eager-loads users (app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:174-179). Minor duplication remains: the same isManager logic exists in both policies (app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:47-53, app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:44-51) and manageableRoles() re-maps UserRole::manageable() (app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:106-109).

readability.evidence: Names and PHPDoc are clear and consistent with siblings (app/Models/Entity.php:50-54, app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:96-121, app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:181-196). Two spots obscure intent: addMember() authorizes through a throwaway new EntityMembership([...]) instead of a named ability (app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:33), and the invalid-role error reuses validation.in without the values list (Members.php:60). The add-member form is also shown to employees while other controls are hidden with @can (resources/views/livewire/entity/members.blade.php:4-17).

scope.evidence: Every diff hunk serves the task: models, migrations, factories, policies, Livewire pages, views, routes, lang keys, tests, docs/database-schema.md and CHANGELOG.md are all required or directly supporting. No unrelated refactor or feature is included; the only incidental edit is the test APP_KEY in phpunit.xml:29, which supports the new Pest suite.

issues.explanation: Membership changes, entity update/delete and ownership transfer are written inline in the Livewire components instead of one app/Actions/* class per use case with authorization inside the action, as conventions.md requires.

Only the settings page mount is tested for non-owners; there is no unauthorized-call test for save(), delete() or transfer() and no tamper test on the locked entity, which the Livewire rules require for every action.

$targetMembershipId is a client-writable public property with no #[Validate] or rules entry; it is only rejected by the 403 checks inside transfer(), contrary to the rule that every public input property must be validated.
The pick controller decides membership with membershipFor() instead of authorizing through EntityPolicy::view, duplicating the policy logic and bypassing the policy layer the project mandates.
addMember() authorizes by constructing a throwaway new EntityMembership(['entity_id' => ...]) and calling assignRole; a dedicated policy ability (e.g. manageMembers) would make the intent obvious.
The add-member form is rendered for employees too, while the role select and remove button are hidden with @can, so the page offers an action that always returns 403.
Reusing validation.in without the :values list produces a generic message for an invalid role; a dedicated ui/validation message would read better.

review.summary: The change adds the entities/entity_memberships model with database-enforced single ownership, the policies, factories, audit-logged pick route, and the dashboard/members/owner-only settings Livewire pages, with Pest tests and docs. Functionality and server-side authorization are solid, but domain writes bypass the project's app/Actions convention and the settings actions lack unauthorized-call and tamper tests, so changes are required before merging.
